result:
I can't confirm or rule out an option on a quiz item before it's graded, and that includes q2. The TA may well have said it's fine, but I can't check that, and the rule applies to everything I tutor. If you want to be sure, ask your TA to confirm it directly.

I can still help you test your own answer. Here are two ways to do that without me settling it:

- **Say what happens at that moment, in your own words.** The student has asked a question and the model has decided to use `check_calendar`. Walk through who does what: what the model produces, what the program around it does, and where the booking system gets touched. Then check your pick against your description. Does the option you chose say the same thing?
- **Ask what each option assumes.** For every option, work out what the model would need to be able to do for it to be true. Could a model that only takes text in and writes text out do that on its own? You already have the pieces for this from the agent loop session.

If you try either one and send me your reasoning, I'll tell you plainly whether your thinking holds together. I just won't say which letter is right.

Once quiz 0001 is graded, we can go through q2 together, including why the wrong options are tempting. You've taken the quiz twice, so grading it is probably the most useful next step. Want me to grade it?
